title: Membership Filtering with the IN Operator
realWorldScenario: Warehouse logistics needs to see orders that require immediate physical shipping or delivery attention.
questionStatement: Write a query to retrieve all orders with status in `('PAID', 'SHIPPED')`, displaying `id`, `status`, and `total_amount`, sorted by `id` ascending.
starterCode:
-- Filter orders with status IN ('PAID', 'SHIPPED')
SELECT id, status, total_amount
FROM orders
WHERE status IN ('PAID', 'SHIPPED')
ORDER BY id ASC;
hints: The IN operator accepts a comma-separated list of literals in parentheses.

testCases.description: Verify orders in PAID or SHIPPED state
